covered_report_window: Friday, August 7, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Monday, August 10, 2026 before the U.S. market open (America/New_York). No qualifying liquid Friday AMC company survived timing confirmation.
market_context_summary: U.S. stocks rose and Treasury yields fell after July payrolls unexpectedly declined by 23,000; rate relief supports long-duration assets, while labor weakness and elevated oil/geopolitical risk raise growth and margin uncertainty.

methodology.disparity_formula: Rounded average of the mean pairwise absolute differences in the three direction scores and the three reversal-risk estimates; 0 is identical outputs and 100 is maximum disagreement.
methodology.lessons_review: No new framework change. Existing hard timing confirmation, key-metric-first, premium-growth priced-in penalty, forward-look override, and low-bar reversal-risk floors were applied.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: HBM and advanced-packaging orders support upside if Q3 guidance validates the promised second-half ramp.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 revenue guide is $129M-$131M; the decisive bar is management's >25% 2H26 versus 1H26 growth outlook.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Q3 guide and backlog conversion exceed the real buy-side bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Orders convert later, or margins disappoint despite revenue growth.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Spot TCE rates and supplemental dividend
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong tanker rates and cash returns favor upside if Q2 spot TCE and the variable dividend meet elevated expectations.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Booked rates and dividend exceed the elevated bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Rate commentary rolls over or cash returns disappoint after the stock's run.

ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Available estimates imply a sharp Q2 earnings step-up; revision evidence had been positive, though the analyst sample is small.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Gross-to-net pressure / spending and launch costs
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AUVELITY momentum and the new Alzheimer-agitation indication favor upside if prescription conversion outruns launch spending and gross-to-net pressure.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AUVELITY adoption and launch commentary materially lift the revenue trajectory.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Gross-to-net discounts, operating losses, or a slower launch overwhelm sales growth.

ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent analysts remained broadly bullish, including several July target reiterations/raises.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong gold pricing and Q1 execution favor upside if Q2 output reaches guidance without an AISC setback.

ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: AISC rises, Q1 inventory benefits reverse, or IPO/project commentary distracts.
